title: Footprints on the Moon Will Last Millions of Years

scenes.text: The Apollo astronauts' footprints are still on the Moon, more than fifty years later.
And NASA says they'll likely stay there for millions of years.
On Earth, a footprint on a beach is gone with the next wave. Rain, wind and plants erase everything eventually.
The Moon has no wind, no rain, no rivers and no active volcanoes. Nothing moves the dust once it settles.
The only real threat is a direct hit from a meteorite, and that comes down to luck over millions of years.
A few steps taken in nineteen sixty-nine, still crisp for a million years. Would you want to leave a footprint up there?
